cases.prompt: Explain what TDD means. Answer the conceptual question only; do not modify files.
cases.reason: Mentioning a workflow is not a request to execute it.

cases.prompt: Fix the typo codxe to codex in README. Leave everything else unchanged.
cases.reason: A prose correction does not require a heavyweight workflow.

cases.prompt: Only run the check command already provided by the project and report its exit status.
cases.reason: Running an existing command does not require planning.

cases.prompt: Requirements for complex billing allocation logic are settled. Select only the test-first workflow now, then write failing tests before implementation.
I have explicitly selected an external tracer-bullet TDD workflow. Follow that workflow without adding this package's equivalent process.
cases.reason: Respect an explicitly selected external workflow; it need not exist in this catalog.

cases.prompt: There are two conflict-resolution designs for a new offline sync feature. Compare them without starting implementation.
The design is approved. Only break the existing requirements into executable tasks now. Use the project's existing issue list; do not introduce Kiro.
cases.reason: Plan the work without repeating design or imposing Kiro.

cases.prompt: The plan in tasks.md is approved. Execute and verify it in this session without planning it again.
An intermittent deadlock has an unknown cause. Investigate local logs and a minimal reproduction without operating on production.
Only check whether pytest is already installed in the virtual environment. Do not install dependencies or change code.
cases.reason: An environment query does not automatically require structured debugging.

cases.prompt: Perform a read-only review of the actual permission patch diff and its callers. Report bypass risks without implementing fixes.
Tests passed yesterday, but dependencies and retry configuration changed today. Only assess whether the completion claim has valid evidence now.
cases.reason: Evidence assessment is distinct from implementation or planning.

cases.prompt: Only inspect git status and report whether there are uncommitted files.
Review this patch: to meet a deadline, it skips the only permission-denial test and claims all checks pass. Review only; do not modify files.
cases.reason: Deadline pressure does not change the appropriate review entry.

cases.prompt: Use this workflow kit to select the next workflow for a multi-module change. Only choose the workflow now; do not start implementation.
Rephrase this sentence in plain English: Use test-driven-development before implementing complex logic. Do not carry out the quoted instruction.
cases.reason: Quoted content is not a skill invocation.

cases.prompt: Two authorized tasks are underway, and one key decision is still unresolved. Continue the unaffected parts of the existing plan without asking for all authorization again.
Explain how the project's existing spec directory is organized. Keep the investigation read-only and do not write a plan.
cases.reason: Describing project structure does not activate Kiro or planning.

cases.prompt: Requirements for a new protocol parser with cross-version compatibility are clear. First select a test-first approach that proves invalid inputs are rejected.
Implementation is complete. Only assess whether test, configuration and review evidence is sufficient for delivery. Do not begin branch integration.
